(()=>{
'use strict';
const API='https://api.wiseoldman.net/v2';
const PLAYERS=[
 {key:'dikste',name:'Dikste',core:true,color:'#a99bb8',portrait:'data:image/webp;base64,',role:'Technical learner · quick on new bosses',mantra:'Wilderness tolerance: zero'},
 {key:'big dog aura',name:'Big Dog Aura',core:true,color:'#e6ad43',portrait:'data:image/webp;base64,',role:'The Founder · strategist with good clicks',mantra:'Wilderness tolerance: too high.'},
 {key:'lijpste',name:'Lijpste',core:true,color:'#d94ff0',portrait:'data:image/webp;base64,',role:'The total package · progression pusher',mantra:'Spooned again. Complaint pending.'},
 {key:'poep aura',name:'Poep Aura',core:false,color:'#d77878',portrait:'data:image/png;base64,',role:'Supporting cast',mantra:'Temple + WOM tracked in the background.'},
 {key:'lompste',name:'Lompste',core:false,color:'#d3b35d',portrait:'data:image/png;base64,',role:'Supporting cast',mantra:'Current WOM tracked · Collection Log not synced.'}
];
const CORE=PLAYERS.filter(p=>p.core), SIDE=PLAYERS.filter(p=>!p.core);
const PERIODS={7:'1 week',30:'1 month',90:'3 months',180:'6 months',365:'1 year'};
const WKEY='ug-v19-wom-cache', HKEY='ug-v19-history-cache', CKEY='ug-v19-chronicle-cache';
const state={profiles:{},gains:{},history:{},temple:null,period:365,mode:'gain'};
const $=(s,r=document)=>r.querySelector(s), $$=(s,r=document)=>[...r.querySelectorAll(s)];
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]));
const fmt=n=>Number.isFinite(+n)?Math.round(+n).toLocaleString('en-GB'):'—';
const fmt1=n=>Number.isFinite(+n)?(+n).toLocaleString('en-GB',{maximumFractionDigits:1}):'—';
const compact=n=>{n=+n;if(!Number.isFinite(n))return'—';const a=Math.abs(n);if(a>=1e9)return(n/1e9).toFixed(a>=1e10?1:2).replace(/\.0+$/,'')+'B';if(a>=1e6)return(n/1e6).toFixed(a>=1e7?1:2).replace(/\.0+$/,'')+'M';if(a>=1e3)return(n/1e3).toFixed(a>=1e4?1:2).replace(/\.0+$/,'')+'K';return fmt(n)};
const nice=s=>String(s||'').replace(/_/g,' ').replace(/\b\w/g,m=>m.toUpperCase()).replace(/Of /g,'of ').replace(/The /g,'the ');
const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));
const dateOnly=x=>{const d=new Date(x);return Number.isNaN(+d)?'—':d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric'})};
const dateTime=x=>{const d=new Date(x);return Number.isNaN(+d)?'—':d.toLocaleString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})};
function loadJSON(k){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)||'null')}catch{return null}}
function saveJSON(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v))}catch{}}
async function fetchJSON(url,{attempts=2,signal}={}){let last;for(let i=0;i<attempts;i++){try{const r=await fetch(url,{headers:{Accept:'application/json'},signal});if(r.ok)return r.json();const e=new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);e.status=r.status;last=e;if(r.status!==429&&r.status<500)throw e;const ra=+r.headers.get('Retry-After');await sleep(ra>0?ra*1000:600*(i+1));}catch(e){last=e;if(signal?.aborted)throw e;if(i===attempts-1)throw e;await sleep(450*(i+1))}}throw last}
function snapData(key){return state.profiles[key]?.latestSnapshot?.data||state.profiles[key]?.latest_snapshot?.data||null}
function overall(key){return snapData(key)?.skills?.overall||{}}
function currentBoss(key,b){const k=+snapData(key)?.bosses?.[b]?.kills;return Number.isFinite(k)&&k>=0?k:null}
function currentComputed(key,k){const v=+snapData(key)?.computed?.[k]?.value;return Number.isFinite(v)?v:+state.profiles[key]?.[k]||0}
function playerByKey(k){return PLAYERS.find(p=>p.key===k)}
function rankValues(vals){const pairs=vals.map((v,i)=>({v:+v,i})).filter(x=>Number.isFinite(x.v)).sort((a,b)=>b.v-a.v);const ranks=Array(vals.length).fill(0);let last=null,rank=0;pairs.forEach((x,pos)=>{if(last===null||x.v!==last)rank=pos+1;ranks[x.i]=rank;last=x.v});return ranks}
function ordinalRank(rank){return rank===1?'1st':rank===2?'2nd':rank===3?'3rd':rank===4?'4th':rank===5?'5th':rank+'th'}
function rankCell(v,rank,sub=''){return `<td class="${rank?`rank-${rank}`:''}"><b>${esc(v)}</b>${sub?`<small style="display:block;color:#827662">${esc(sub)}</small>`:''}${rank?`<span class="rank-chip">${ordinalRank(rank)}</span>`:''}</td>`}
function setNotice(msg,kind=''){const n=$('#pageNotice');if(n)n.innerHTML=msg?`<div class="notice ${kind}">${msg}</div>`:''}
async function loadTemple(){try{const r=await fetch(`data/temple-clog.json?v=${Date.now()}`,{cache:'no-store'});if(!r.ok)throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);state.temple=await r.json();return state.temple}catch(e){console.warn('Temple cache unavailable',e);return null}}
function templePlayers(){return state.temple?.players||{}}
function templeItemsFor(key){const p=templePlayers()[key];const data=p?.data??p;let arr=data?.items||[];if(Array.isArray(arr))return arr;const out=[];const walk=n=>{if(!n||typeof n!=='object')return;for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(n)){if(v&&typeof v==='object'&&Number.isFinite(+v.id))out.push(v);else if(v&&typeof v==='object')walk(v)}};walk(arr);return out}
function templeRecent(){let r=state.temple?.recent||state.temple?.recent_items||[];if(!Array.isArray(r)){if(r?.data)r=Array.isArray(r.data)?r.data:Object.values(r.data);else r=Object.values(r||{})}return r.filter(Boolean).map(x=>({id:+x.id,name:x.name||`Item ${x.id}`,player:x.player_name_with_capitalization||x.player||x.username,date:x.date_unix?+x.date_unix*1000:(x.date?+new Date(x.date):0),notable:!!(x.notable_item??x.notable)})).filter(x=>x.id&&x.date).sort((a,b)=>b.date-a.date)}
function templeCoverage(){const syncedKeys=PLAYERS.filter(p=>templePlayers()[p.key]).map(p=>p.key);return {synced:syncedKeys.length,total:PLAYERS.length,syncedKeys,unsyncedKeys:PLAYERS.filter(p=>!syncedKeys.includes(p.key)).map(p=>p.key)}}
function templeGroupStats(){const keys=templeCoverage().syncedKeys;const itemSets={};let known=new Set();for(const k of keys){const arr=templeItemsFor(k);itemSets[k]=new Set();for(const it of arr){const id=+it.id,count=+(it.count??it.quantity??0);if(!id)continue;known.add(id);if(count>0)itemSets[k].add(id)}}const catalog=state.temple?.catalog||state.temple?.items_catalog||state.temple?.all_items;if(catalog){const vals=Array.isArray(catalog)?catalog:Object.entries(catalog).map(([id,name])=>({id:+id,name}));for(const x of vals){const id=+(x.id??x[0]);if(id)known.add(id)}}const union=new Set();Object.values(itemSets).forEach(s=>s.forEach(id=>union.add(id)));const total=state.temple?.total_collections_available||Math.max(known.size,...Object.values(templePlayers()).map(p=>+(p?.data?.total_collections_available||0)));return {known:total||known.size,got:union.size,sets:itemSets}}
async function loadWomCurrent(force=false){const cached=loadJSON(WKEY);if(!force&&cached?.profiles){state.profiles=cached.profiles;state.gains=cached.gains||{};return 'browser cache'}
 try{const r=await fetch(`data/wom-cache.json?v=${Date.now()}`,{cache:'no-store'});if(r.ok){const doc=await r.json();if(doc?.profiles){state.profiles=doc.profiles;state.gains=doc.gains||{};saveJSON(WKEY,{savedAt:doc.fetchedAt||Date.now(),profiles:state.profiles,gains:state.gains});return 'shared cache'}}}catch{}
 const profiles={};for(const p of PLAYERS){try{profiles[p.key]=await fetchJSON(`${API}/players/${encodeURIComponent(p.name)}`,{attempts:2})}catch(e){console.warn(p.name,e)}await sleep(170)}state.profiles=profiles;saveJSON(WKEY,{savedAt:Date.now(),profiles,gains:state.gains});return 'WOM network'}
async function gainForPeriod(days,force=false){const map={7:'week',30:'month',365:'year'},period=map[days];if(!period)return null;state.gains[period]=state.gains[period]||{};for(const p of CORE){if(!force&&state.gains[period][p.key]?.data)continue;try{state.gains[period][p.key]=await fetchJSON(`${API}/players/${encodeURIComponent(p.name)}/gained?period=${period}`,{attempts:2})}catch(e){console.warn('gain',p.name,e)}await sleep(170)}const old=loadJSON(WKEY)||{};saveJSON(WKEY,{...old,savedAt:Date.now(),profiles:state.profiles,gains:state.gains});return state.gains[period]}
async function directRefreshWom(){setNotice('Refreshing all five WOM profiles. Please do not click again while this is running.','warn');for(const p of PLAYERS){try{await fetch(`${API}/players/${encodeURIComponent(p.name)}`,{method:'POST',headers:{Accept:'application/json','Content-Type':'application/json'}})}catch{}await sleep(700)}localStorage.removeItem(WKEY);await loadWomCurrent(true);setNotice('WOM refresh finished. Current browser cache has been replaced.','')}
function updateDataStatus(source='saved'){const wc=loadJSON(WKEY);const wom=$('[data-wom-status]');if(wom){const b=$('b',wom),d=$('.dot',wom);b.textContent=wc?.savedAt?`saved ${dateOnly(wc.savedAt)}`:source;d.classList.add(Object.keys(state.profiles).length?'ok':'warn')}const t=$('[data-temple-status]');if(t){const b=$('b',t),d=$('.dot',t);const at=state.temple?.fetchedAt||state.temple?.fetched_at;b.textContent=at?`cache ${dateOnly(at)}`:(state.temple?'cache loaded':'unavailable');d.classList.add(state.temple?'ok':'warn')}$$('[data-period-status]').forEach(x=>x.textContent=PERIODS[state.period]||`${state.period} days`)}
function bindCommon(){$$('[data-refresh-wom]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=async()=>{b.disabled=true;const old=b.textContent;b.textContent='Refreshing…';try{await directRefreshWom();renderPage()}finally{b.disabled=false;b.textContent=old}});$$('[data-reload-temple]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=async()=>{b.disabled=true;const old=b.textContent;b.textContent='Reloading…';await loadTemple();renderMast();renderPage();b.disabled=false;b.textContent=old});$$('[data-shared-refresh]').forEach(a=>a.href='https://github.com/MarnixS/fun/actions');$$('[data-period-button]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=async()=>{state.period=+b.dataset.periodButton;$$('[data-period-button]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',+x.dataset.periodButton===state.period));$$('[data-period-copy]').forEach(x=>x.textContent=PERIODS[state.period]);updateDataStatus();await gainForPeriod(state.period);renderPage()});$$('[data-mode]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{state.mode=b.dataset.mode;$$('[data-mode]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b));renderProgressCharts()})}
function renderMast(){const gs=templeGroupStats(),cov=templeCoverage();const totalXp=PLAYERS.reduce((n,p)=>n+(+overall(p.key).experience||0),0);$$('[data-mast-log]').forEach(x=>x.textContent=gs.known?`${fmt(gs.got)} / ${fmt(gs.known)}`:'—');$$('[data-mast-log-sub]').forEach(x=>{const uns=cov.unsyncedKeys.map(k=>playerByKey(k)?.name||k);x.textContent=`${cov.synced}/${cov.total} Clogs synced${uns.length?' · '+uns.join(', ')+' unsynced':''}`});$$('[data-mast-xp]').forEach(x=>x.textContent=totalXp?compact(totalXp):'—');const dr=templeRecent()[0];$$('[data-mast-drop]').forEach(x=>x.textContent=dr?.name||'No recent feed yet');$$('[data-mast-drop-sub]').forEach(x=>x.textContent=dr?`${dr.player||'Group'} · ${dateOnly(dr.date)}`:'Temple recent items');$$('[data-mast-drop-icon]').forEach(x=>{if(dr){x.src=`https://static.runelite.net/cache/item/icon/${dr.id}.png`;x.hidden=false}else x.hidden=true});const wc=loadJSON(WKEY);$$('[data-mast-refresh]').forEach(x=>x.textContent=wc?.savedAt?dateOnly(wc.savedAt):'First load');$$('[data-mast-refresh-sub]').forEach(x=>x.textContent=state.temple?.fetchedAt?`Temple cache ${dateOnly(state.temple.fetchedAt)}`:'Refresh deliberately below')}
function cardFor(p,side=false){const o=overall(p.key),d=snapData(p.key),ehp=currentComputed(p.key,'ehp'),ehb=currentComputed(p.key,'ehb'),raid=['chambers_of_xeric','chambers_of_xeric_challenge_mode','theatre_of_blood','theatre_of_blood_hard_mode','tombs_of_amascut','tombs_of_amascut_expert'].reduce((n,b)=>n+(currentBoss(p.key,b)||0),0);if(side){const clogSynced=!!templePlayers()[p.key];return `<article class="side-card" style="--pc:${p.color}"><img src="${p.portrait}" alt="${p.name}"><div><h3>${p.name}</h3><div class="side-rule">${p.role} · ${clogSynced?'WOM + Temple background member':'WOM tracked · Collection Log currently unsynced'}</div><div class="side-stats"><div><span>Total level</span><b>${fmt(o.level)}</b></div><div><span>Total XP</span><b>${compact(o.experience)}</b></div><div><span>EHP / EHB</span><b>${fmt1(ehp)} / ${fmt1(ehb)}</b></div></div><span class="side-badge">${clogSynced?'Collection Log synced':'Collection Log not synced · excluded from Clog totals'}</span></div></article>`}
 return `<article class="player-card" style="--pc:${p.color}"><div class="player-card-head"><img class="player-portrait" src="${p.portrait}" onerror="this.style.display='none'" alt="${p.name}"><div><h3>${p.name}</h3><div class="player-role">${p.role}</div></div></div><div class="player-mantra">${p.mantra}</div><div class="stat-grid"><div class="stat-box"><span>Total level</span><b>${fmt(o.level)}</b></div><div class="stat-box"><span>Total XP</span><b>${compact(o.experience)}</b></div><div class="stat-box"><span>EHP</span><b>${fmt1(ehp)}</b></div><div class="stat-box"><span>EHB</span><b>${fmt1(ehb)}</b></div><div class="stat-box"><span>Raid KC</span><b>${fmt(raid)}</b></div><div class="stat-box"><span>Updated</span><b style="font-size:11px">${dateOnly(state.profiles[p.key]?.updatedAt||state.profiles[p.key]?.latestSnapshot?.createdAt)}</b></div></div></article>`}
function renderOverview(){const pc=$('#playerCards');if(pc)pc.innerHTML=CORE.map(p=>cardFor(p)).join('');const sc=$('#sideCastGrid');if(sc)sc.innerHTML=SIDE.map(p=>cardFor(p,true)).join('');renderStanding();renderGainCards();renderGimTeaser()}
function renderStanding(){const t=$('#standingTable');if(!t)return;const metrics=[['Total level',p=>+overall(p.key).level||0],['Total XP',p=>+overall(p.key).experience||0],['EHP',p=>currentComputed(p.key,'ehp')],['EHB',p=>currentComputed(p.key,'ehb')],['99s',p=>Object.entries(snapData(p.key)?.skills||{}).filter(([k,v])=>k!=='overall'&&+v.level>=99).length]];let h='<thead><tr><th>Metric</th>'+CORE.map(p=>`<th>${p.name}</th>`).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>';for(const [label,fn] of metrics){const vals=CORE.map(fn),r=rankValues(vals);h+=`<tr><td>${label}</td>${vals.map((v,i)=>rankCell(label.includes('XP')?compact(v):label.includes('E')?fmt1(v):fmt(v),r[i])).join('')}</tr>`}t.innerHTML=h+'</tbody>'}
function gainNode(key){const map={7:'week',30:'month',365:'year'},g=state.gains[map[state.period]]?.[key]?.data;if(g)return g;return null}
function gainXp(p){return +(gainNode(p.key)?.skills?.overall?.experience?.gained||0)}
function gainLevel(p){return +(gainNode(p.key)?.skills?.overall?.level?.gained||0)}
function topGainSkill(p){const s=gainNode(p.key)?.skills||{};let best=null;for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(s)){if(k==='overall')continue;const x=+v?.experience?.gained||0;if(!best||x>best.x)best={k,x}}return best}
function renderGainCards(){const host=$('#gainCards');if(!host)return;const vals=CORE.map(gainXp),r=rankValues(vals);host.innerHTML=CORE.map((p,i)=>{const top=topGainSkill(p);return `<article class="gain-card rank-${r[i]||3}" style="--pc:${p.color}"><div class="name">${p.name}</div><div class="big">+${compact(vals[i])}</div><small>${PERIODS[state.period]} · ${gainLevel(p)>=0?'+':''}${fmt(gainLevel(p))} total levels</small><div class="top">Top skill: ${top?`<button class="metric-link" data-skill="${top.k}" data-recent="1" style="border:0;background:none;color:#dbc17e;padding:0">${nice(top.k)}</button> · +${compact(top.x)}`:'No exact WOM gain endpoint for this window yet'}</div></article>`}).join('')}
function renderGimTeaser(){const h=$('#gimTeaser');if(!h)return;const gs=templeGroupStats(),cov=templeCoverage();h.innerHTML=`<div class="section-head" style="margin:0"><div><div class="eyebrow">GROUP IRONMAN TRACKER</div><h2>The full five-man group</h2><div class="section-note">The site follows all five members, while the core statistical rivalry stays focused on Dikste, Big Dog Aura and Lijpste.</div></div><a class="btn" href="gim.html">Open tracker →</a></div><div class="kpi-grid"><div class="kpi"><span>GIM size</span><b>5</b></div><div class="kpi"><span>WOM tracked</span><b>${PLAYERS.filter(p=>state.profiles[p.key]).length}/5</b></div><div class="kpi"><span>Clogs synced</span><b>${cov.synced}/5</b></div><div class="kpi"><span>Tracked group uniques</span><b>${gs.got?fmt(gs.got):'—'}</b></div></div>`}
function renderHiscores(){renderCurrentSkills();renderCurrentBosses();const side=$('#hiscoreSide');if(side)side.innerHTML=SIDE.map(p=>cardFor(p,true)).join('')}
function renderCurrentSkills(){const t=$('#currentSkillsTable');if(!t)return;const skills=new Set();CORE.forEach(p=>Object.keys(snapData(p.key)?.skills||{}).forEach(k=>{if(k!=='overall')skills.add(k)}));const order=[...skills];let h='<thead><tr><th>Skill</th>'+CORE.map(p=>`<th>${p.name}</th>`).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>';for(const k of order){const vals=CORE.map(p=>+snapData(p.key)?.skills?.[k]?.experience||0),r=rankValues(vals);h+=`<tr><td><button class="metric-link" data-skill="${k}" style="border:0;background:none;color:inherit;padding:0">${nice(k)}</button></td>${CORE.map((p,i)=>{const x=snapData(p.key)?.skills?.[k]||{};return rankCell(`Lv ${fmt(x.level)} · ${compact(x.experience)} XP`,r[i])}).join('')}</tr>`}t.innerHTML=h+'</tbody>'}
function bossKeys(){const s=new Set();CORE.forEach(p=>Object.keys(snapData(p.key)?.bosses||{}).forEach(k=>{if(CORE.some(q=>(currentBoss(q.key,k)||0)>0))s.add(k)}));return [...s].sort((a,b)=>Math.max(...CORE.map(p=>currentBoss(p.key,b)||0))-Math.max(...CORE.map(p=>currentBoss(p.key,a)||0)))}
function renderCurrentBosses(){const t=$('#bossTable');if(!t)return;let h='<thead><tr><th>Boss</th>'+CORE.map(p=>`<th>${p.name}</th>`).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>';for(const k of bossKeys().slice(0,45)){const vals=CORE.map(p=>currentBoss(p.key,k)??0),r=rankValues(vals);h+=`<tr><td>${nice(k)}</td>${vals.map((v,i)=>rankCell(fmt(v),r[i])).join('')}</tr>`}t.innerHTML=h+'</tbody>'}
async function setPeriod(days){state.period=days;$$('[data-period-button]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',+x.dataset.periodButton===days));$$('[data-period-copy]').forEach(x=>x.textContent=PERIODS[days]);updateDataStatus();if([7,30,365].includes(days))await gainForPeriod(days);renderPage()}
function currentHistory(key){return state.history[key]||[]}
async function historyWindow(key,days=365){const cache=loadJSON(HKEY)||{};const ck=`window:${key}:${days}`,hit=cache[ck];if(hit?.data?.length){state.history[key]=hit.data;return hit.data}const end=new Date(),start=new Date(end.getTime()-days*864e5);try{const data=await fetchJSON(`${API}/players/${encodeURIComponent(playerByKey(key).name)}/snapshots?startDate=${encodeURIComponent(start.toISOString())}&endDate=${encodeURIComponent(end.toISOString())}&limit=50&offset=0`,{attempts:2});const arr=(Array.isArray(data)?data:[]).sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.createdAt)-new Date(b.createdAt));state.history[key]=arr;cache[ck]={savedAt:Date.now(),data:arr};saveJSON(HKEY,cache);return arr}catch(e){console.warn(e);return []}}
function lineSeriesFromHistory(metric,kind='skill'){return CORE.map(p=>({name:p.name,color:p.color,data:currentHistory(p.key).map(s=>{let v;if(kind==='skill')v=s.data?.skills?.[metric]?.experience;else if(kind==='level')v=s.data?.skills?.overall?.level;else if(kind==='computed')v=s.data?.computed?.[metric]?.value;else if(kind==='boss')v=s.data?.bosses?.[metric]?.kills;return {date:s.createdAt,value:Number.isFinite(+v)&&+v>=0?+v:null}}).filter(x=>x.value!=null)}))}
function drawLine(host,series,{floorZero=false,format='compact',gainMode=false}={}){if(typeof host==='string')host=$(host);if(!host)return;host.innerHTML='';let ss=series.map(s=>({...s,data:s.data.slice().sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.date)-new Date(b.date))}));if(gainMode)ss=ss.map(s=>{if(!s.data.length)return s;const base=s.data[0].value;return {...s,data:s.data.map(x=>({...x,value:x.value-base}))}});const all=ss.flatMap(s=>s.data).filter(x=>Number.isFinite(+x.value));if(!all.length){host.innerHTML='<div class="muted" style="padding:85px 12px;text-align:center">No saved WOM datapoints for this view.</div>';return}const W=900,H=300,p={l:62,r:18,t:16,b:36},xs=all.map(x=>+new Date(x.date)),ys=all.map(x=>+x.value);let minX=Math.min(...xs),maxX=Math.max(...xs);if(minX===maxX)maxX+=864e5;let minY=floorZero?0:Math.min(...ys),maxY=Math.max(...ys);if(gainMode)minY=Math.min(0,minY);if(maxY===minY)maxY=minY+1;const span=maxY-minY;if(!floorZero)minY-=span*.06;maxY+=span*.08;const X=t=>p.l+(t-minX)/Math.max(1,maxX-minX)*(W-p.l-p.r),Y=v=>p.t+(maxY-v)/Math.max(1,maxY-minY)*(H-p.t-p.b),ns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg',svg=document.createElementNS(ns,'svg');svg.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${W} ${H}`);for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const yy=p.t+i*(H-p.t-p.b)/4,v=maxY-i*(maxY-minY)/4;const ln=document.createElementNS(ns,'line');Object.entries({x1:p.l,x2:W-p.r,y1:yy,y2:yy,stroke:'#3a2d1d'}).forEach(([k,z])=>ln.setAttribute(k,z));svg.append(ln);const tx=document.createElementNS(ns,'text');tx.setAttribute('x',p.l-7);tx.setAttribute('y',yy+4);tx.setAttribute('text-anchor','end');tx.setAttribute('fill','#8f8069');tx.setAttribute('font-size','10');tx.textContent=format==='hours'?fmt1(v):compact(v);svg.append(tx)}for(let async function renderProgress(){renderGainCards();await Promise.all(CORE.map(p=>historyWindow(p.key,state.period)));renderProgressCharts();renderProgressSelectors();renderSkillGainTable();renderBossGainTable()}
function renderProgressCharts(){if(!$('#xpChart'))return;drawLine('#xpChart',lineSeriesFromHistory('overall','skill'),{gainMode:state.mode==='gain'});drawLine('#levelChart',lineSeriesFromHistory('overall','level'),{gainMode:state.mode==='gain'});drawLine('#ehpChart',lineSeriesFromHistory('ehp','computed'),{format:'hours',gainMode:state.mode==='gain'});drawLine('#ehbChart',lineSeriesFromHistory('ehb','computed'),{format:'hours',gainMode:state.mode==='gain'});const sk=$('#skillSelect')?.value;if(sk){$('#skillChartTitle').textContent=nice(sk)+' XP';drawLine('#skillChart',lineSeriesFromHistory(sk,'skill'),{gainMode:state.mode==='gain'})}const bk=$('#bossSelect')?.value;if(bk){$('#bossChartTitle').textContent=nice(bk)+' KC';drawLine('#bossChart',lineSeriesFromHistory(bk,'boss'),{floorZero:true,gainMode:state.mode==='gain'})}}
function renderProgressSelectors(){const ss=$('#skillSelect'),bs=$('#bossSelect');if(ss&&!ss.options.length){const ks=Object.keys(snapData(CORE[0].key)?.skills||{}).filter(k=>k!=='overall');ss.innerHTML=ks.map(k=>`<option value="${k}">${nice(k)}</option>`).join('');ss.onchange=()=>renderProgressCharts()}if(bs&&!bs.options.length){const ks=bossKeys();bs.innerHTML=ks.map(k=>`<option value="${k}">${nice(k)}</option>`).join('');bs.onchange=()=>renderProgressCharts()}renderProgressCharts()}
function skillGain(key,skill){return +(gainNode(key)?.skills?.[skill]?.experience?.gained||0)}
function renderSkillGainTable(){const t=$('#skillGainTable');if(!t)return;const ks=Object.keys(gainNode(CORE[0].key)?.skills||{}).filter(k=>k!=='overall');let h='<thead><tr><th>Skill</th>'+CORE.map(p=>`<th>${p.name}</th>`).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>';for(const k of ks){const vals=CORE.map(p=>skillGain(p.key,k)),r=rankValues(vals);h+=`<tr><td><button class="metric-link" data-skill="${k}" data-recent="1" style="border:0;background:none;color:inherit;padding:0">${nice(k)}</button></td>${vals.map((v,i)=>rankCell('+'+compact(v),r[i])).join('')}</tr>`}t.innerHTML=h+'</tbody>'}
function renderBossGainTable(){const t=$('#bossGainTable');if(!t)return;const obj=gainNode(CORE[0].key)?.bosses||{};const ks=new Set(Object.keys(obj));CORE.slice(1).forEach(p=>Object.keys(gainNode(p.key)?.bosses||{}).forEach(k=>ks.add(k)));const rows=[...ks].map(k=>({k,vals:CORE.map(p=>Math.max(0,+(gainNode(p.key)?.bosses?.[k]?.kills?.gained||0)))})).filter(r=>r.vals.some(v=>v>0)).sort((a,b)=>Math.max(...b.vals)-Math.max(...a.vals));let h='<thead><tr><th>Boss</th>'+CORE.map(p=>`<th>${p.name}</th>`).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>';for(const row of rows){const ranks=rankValues(row.vals);h+=`<tr><td>${nice(row.k)}</td>${row.vals.map((v,i)=>rankCell('+'+fmt(v),ranks[i])).join('')}</tr>`}t.innerHTML=h+'</tbody>'}
function renderGim(){const gs=templeGroupStats(),cov=templeCoverage(),k=$('#gimKpis');if(k){const uns=cov.unsyncedKeys.map(k=>playerByKey(k)?.name||k);k.innerHTML=`<div class="kpi"><span>Tracked group uniques</span><b>${fmt(gs.got)}</b></div><div class="kpi"><span>Temple catalogue</span><b>${fmt(gs.known)}</b></div><div class="kpi"><span>Clogs synced</span><b>${cov.synced}/${cov.total}</b></div><div class="kpi"><span>Unsynced</span><b>${uns.length?esc(uns.join(', ')):'None'}</b></div>`};const bar=$('#gimProgress');if(bar&&gs.known)bar.style.width=Math.min(100,100*gs.got/gs.known)+'%';renderDrops();renderClogItems();renderGimMembers();renderFiveStanding();bindGimTabs()}
function renderGimMembers(){const h=$('#gimMembers');if(!h)return;const gs=templeGroupStats();h.innerHTML=PLAYERS.map(p=>{const count=gs.sets[p.key]?.size;return `<div class="kpi"><span>${p.name}${p.core?'':' · side'}</span><b>${count==null?'not synced':fmt(count)}</b></div>`}).join('')}
function renderFiveStanding(){const t=$('#fiveStandingTable');if(!t)return;const rows=[['Total level',p=>+overall(p.key).level||0,'int'],['Total XP',p=>+overall(p.key).experience||0,'xp'],['EHP',p=>currentComputed(p.key,'ehp'),'hours'],['EHB',p=>currentComputed(p.key,'ehb'),'hours']];let h='<thead><tr><th>Metric</th>'+PLAYERS.map(p=>`<th>${p.name}</th>`).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>';for(const [label,get,kind] of rows){const vals=PLAYERS.map(get),r=rankValues(vals);h+=`<tr><td>${label}</td>${vals.map((v,i)=>rankCell(kind==='xp'?compact(v):kind==='hours'?fmt1(v):fmt(v),r[i])).join('')}</tr>`}t.innerHTML=h+'</tbody>'}
function renderDrops(){const arr=templeRecent().slice(0,30),html=arr.length?arr.map(d=>`<article class="drop-card ${d.notable?'notable':''}"><img src="https://static.runelite.net/cache/item/icon/${d.id}.png" alt=""><div><b>${esc(d.name)}</b><small>${esc(d.player||'Group')} · ${dateOnly(d.date)}${d.notable?' · notable':''}</small></div></article>`).join(''):'<div class="notice">No cached Temple recent-drop feed yet. It will populate after the next shared data refresh.</div>';['#recentDrops','#recentDrops2'].forEach(sel=>{const h=$(sel);if(h)h.innerHTML=html})}
function clogRows(){const map=new Map();const synced=new Set(templeCoverage().syncedKeys);for(const p of PLAYERS){if(!synced.has(p.key))continue;for(const it of templeItemsFor(p.key)){const id=+it.id;if(!id)continue;let x=map.get(id)||{id,name:it.name||`Item ${id}`,owners:{},counts:{}};x.name=it.name||x.name;x.counts[p.key]=+(it.count??it.quantity??0);x.owners[p.key]=x.counts[p.key]>0;map.set(id,x)}}return [...map.values()]}
let clogPage=0;function renderClogItems(){const t=$('#clogItemTable');if(!t)return;let arr=clogRows(),q=($('#clogSearch')?.value||'').toLowerCase(),status=$('#clogStatus')?.value||'all',sort=$('#clogSort')?.value||'name';if(q)arr=arr.filter(x=>x.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));if(status==='missing')arr=arr.filter(x=>templeCoverage().syncedKeys.every(k=>!x.owners[k]));if(status==='group')arr=arr.filter(x=>Object.values(x.owners).some(Boolean));if(sort==='owners')arr.sort((a,b)=>Object.values(b.owners).filter(Boolean).length-Object.values(a.owners).filter(Boolean).length||a.name.localeCompare(b.name));else arr.sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name));const size=100,pages=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(arr.length/size));clogPage=Math.max(0,Math.min(clogPage,pages-1));const show=arr.slice(clogPage*size,(clogPage+1)*size);const syncedPlayers=PLAYERS.filter(p=>templePlayers()[p.key]);let h='<thead><tr><th>Item</th>'+syncedPlayers.map(p=>`<th>${p.name}</th>`).join('')+'<th>Owners</th></tr></thead><tbody>';for(const x of show){const ownerCount=Object.values(x.owners).filter(Boolean).length;h+=`<tr><td><div class="item-cell"><img src="https://static.runelite.net/cache/item/icon/${x.id}.png" alt=""><span>${esc(x.name)}</span></div></td>${syncedPlayers.map(p=>`<td>${x.owners[p.key]?`×${fmt(x.counts[p.key]||1)}`:'—'}</td>`).join('')}<td>${ownerCount}/${syncedPlayers.length}</td></tr>`}t.innerHTML=h+'</tbody>';const pi=$('#clogPageInfo');if(pi)pi.textContent=`${fmt(arr.length)} matching items · page ${clogPage+1}/${pages}`;const prev=$('#clogPrev'),next=$('#clogNext');if(prev){prev.disabled=clogPage===0;prev.onclick=()=>{clogPage--;renderClogItems()}}if(next){next.disabled=clogPage>=pages-1;next.onclick=()=>{clogPage++;renderClogItems()}}}
function bindGimTabs(){const buttons=$$('[data-gim-tab]'),panels=$$('[data-gim-panel]');buttons.forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{buttons.forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b));panels.forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle('hidden',p.dataset.gimPanel!==b.dataset.gimTab))});$('#clogSearch')?.addEventListener('input',()=>{clogPage=0;renderClogItems()});$('#clogStatus')?.addEventListener('change',()=>{clogPage=0;renderClogItems()});$('#clogSort')?.addEventListener('change',()=>{clogPage=0;renderClogItems()})}
async function findNearestSnapshot(p,target){const cache=loadJSON(HKEY)||{},day=target.toISOString().slice(0,10),ck=`nearest:${p.key}:${day}`,hit=cache[ck];if(hit?.snap)return hit;const spans=[45,180,730];for(const span of spans){const start=new Date(+target-span*864e5),end=new Date(+target+span*864e5);try{const j=await fetchJSON(`${API}/players/${encodeURIComponent(p.name)}/snapshots?startDate=${encodeURIComponent(start.toISOString())}&endDate=${encodeURIComponent(end.toISOString())}&limit=50&offset=0`,{attempts:2});const arr=Array.isArray(j)?j:[];if(arr.length){const snap=arr.reduce((best,s)=>Math.abs(+new Date(s.createdAt)-+target)<Math.abs(+new Date(best.createdAt)-+target)?s:best,arr[0]),diffDays=Math.abs(+new Date(snap.createdAt)-+target)/864e5;const rec={snap,diffDays,savedAt:Date.now()};cache[ck]=rec;saveJSON(HKEY,cache);return rec}}catch(e){console.warn('time machine',p.name,e)}await sleep(120)}return {snap:null,diffDays:null}}
function snapshotMetric(s,kind,key){if(!s)return null;if(kind==='skillxp')return +s.data?.skills?.[key]?.experience;if(kind==='level')return +s.data?.skills?.overall?.level;if(kind==='computed')return +s.data?.computed?.[key]?.value;if(kind==='boss')return +s.data?.bosses?.[key]?.kills;return null}
function quality(diff){if(diff==null)return['approx','No datapoint'];if(diff<.6)return['exact','Same day'];if(diff<=7)return['near',`${Math.round(diff)} days away`];return['approx',`${Math.round(diff)} days away`]}
async function runTimeMachine(dateStr){const target=new Date(`${dateStr}T12:00:00`);if(Number.isNaN(+target))return;const go=$('#timeGo');if(go){go.disabled=true;go.textContent='Searching WOM…'}setNotice('Finding the nearest recorded WOM snapshot for each member. The date may be before or after your selected day if that is the closest real datapoint.','warn');const res={};for(const p of PLAYERS){res[p.key]=await findNearestSnapshot(p,target);await sleep(120)}renderTimeResults(target,res);setNotice('');if(go){go.disabled=false;go.textContent='Enter the time machine'}}
function renderTimeResults(target,res){const title=$('#timeResultBanner');if(title)title.innerHTML=`<strong>TIME MACHINE · ${dateOnly(target)}</strong><span>Nearest real WOM datapoints are used, even if they fall slightly before or after the requested date. Nothing between snapshots is invented.</span>`;const host=$('#timeCore');if(host)host.innerHTML=CORE.map(p=>timeCard(p,res[p.key])).join('');const side=$('#timeSide');if(side)side.innerHTML=SIDE.map(p=>timeCard(p,res[p.key],true)).join('');renderTimeStanding(res);renderTimeSkills(res);renderTimeBosses(res)}
function timeCard(p,r,side=false){const s=r?.snap,o=s?.data?.skills?.overall||{},now=overall(p.key),ehp=+s?.data?.computed?.ehp?.value,ehb=+s?.data?.computed?.ehb?.value,[qc,ql]=quality(r?.diffDays);if(!s)return `<article class="${side?'side-card':'time-card'}" style="--pc:${p.color}"><div><h3>${p.name}</h3><div class="muted">No WOM snapshot found around this date.</div></div></article>`;return `<article class="time-card" style="--pc:${p.color};${side?'opacity:.7':''}"><div class="snap-date">Actual snapshot ${dateTime(s.createdAt)}</div><h3>${p.name}</h3><div class="time-metrics"><div class="time-metric"><span>Total level</span><b>${fmt(o.level)}</b><em>→ now ${fmt(now.level)} · ${(+now.level||0)-(+o.level||0)>=0?'+':''}${fmt((+now.level||0)-(+o.level||0))}</em></div><div class="time-metric"><span>Total XP</span><b>${compact(o.experience)}</b><em>→ +${compact((+now.experience||0)-(+o.experience||0))}</em></div><div class="time-metric"><span>EHP</span><b>${fmt1(ehp)}</b><em>→ ${fmt1(currentComputed(p.key,'ehp'))}</em></div><div class="time-metric"><span>EHB</span><b>${fmt1(ehb)}</b><em>→ ${fmt1(currentComputed(p.key,'ehb'))}</em></div></div><span class="quality ${qc}">${ql}</span></article>`}
function renderTimeStanding(res){const t=$('#timeStanding');if(!t)return;const rows=[['Total level',p=>+res[p.key]?.snap?.data?.skills?.overall?.level],['Total XP',p=>+res[p.key]?.snap?.data?.skills?.overall?.experience],['EHP',p=>+res[p.key]?.snap?.data?.computed?.ehp?.value],['EHB',p=>+res[p.key]?.snap?.data?.computed?.ehb?.value]];let h='<thead><tr><th>Metric</th>'+CORE.map(p=>`<th>${p.name}</th>`).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>';for(const [l,f] of rows){const vals=CORE.map(f),r=rankValues(vals);h+=`<tr><td>${l}</td>${vals.map((v,i)=>rankCell(l==='Total XP'?compact(v):l.startsWith('E')?fmt1(v):fmt(v),r[i])).join('')}</tr>`}t.innerHTML=h+'</tbody>'}
function renderTimeSkills(res){const t=$('#timeSkills');if(!t)return;const ks=Object.keys(res[CORE[0].key]?.snap?.data?.skills||{}).filter(k=>k!=='overall');let h='<thead><tr><th>Skill</th>'+CORE.map(p=>`<th>${p.name}</th>`).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>';for(const k of ks){const vals=CORE.map(p=>+res[p.key]?.snap?.data?.skills?.[k]?.experience||0),r=rankValues(vals);h+=`<tr><td>${nice(k)}</td>${CORE.map((p,i)=>{const x=res[p.key]?.snap?.data?.skills?.[k];return rankCell(x?`Lv ${fmt(x.level)} · ${compact(x.experience)}`:'—',r[i])}).join('')}</tr>`}t.innerHTML=h+'</tbody>'}
function renderTimeBosses(res){const t=$('#timeBosses');if(!t)return;const ks=new Set();CORE.forEach(p=>Object.keys(res[p.key]?.snap?.data?.bosses||{}).forEach(k=>{if(CORE.some(q=>(+res[q.key]?.snap?.data?.bosses?.[k]?.kills||0)>0))ks.add(k)}));const rows=[...ks].map(k=>({k,vals:CORE.map(p=>Math.max(0,+res[p.key]?.snap?.data?.bosses?.[k]?.kills||0))})).sort((a,b)=>Math.max(...b.vals)-Math.max(...a.vals)).slice(0,35);let h='<thead><tr><th>Boss</th>'+CORE.map(p=>`<th>${p.name}</th>`).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>';for(const x of rows){const r=rankValues(x.vals);h+=`<tr><td>${nice(x.k)}</td>${x.vals.map((v,i)=>rankCell(fmt(v),r[i])).join('')}</tr>`}t.innerHTML=h+'</tbody>'}
async function renderTimeMachine(){const inp=$('#timeDate');if(!inp)return;inp.max=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);if(!inp.value){const d=new Date();d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear()-1);inp.value=d.toISOString().slice(0,10)}$('#timeGo').onclick=()=>runTimeMachine(inp.value);$$('[data-time-preset]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const v=b.dataset.timePreset;if(v==='1y'){const d=new Date();d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear()-1);inp.value=d.toISOString().slice(0,10)}else if(v==='6m'){const d=new Date();d.setMonth(d.getMonth()-6);inp.value=d.toISOString().slice(0,10)}else inp.value=v;runTimeMachine(inp.value)});await runTimeMachine(inp.value)}
async function loadChronicle(force=false){const cached=loadJSON(CKEY);if(!force&&cached?.events?.length)return cached.events;const events=[];for(const p of PLAYERS){try{const a=await fetchJSON(`${API}/players/${encodeURIComponent(p.name)}/achievements`,{attempts:2});for(const x of Array.isArray(a)?a:[]){if(!x.createdAt)continue;events.push({type:'achievement',player:p.name,key:p.key,core:p.core,date:+new Date(x.createdAt),name:x.name,metric:x.metric,measure:x.measure,accuracy:x.accuracy})}}catch(e){console.warn('achievements',p.name,e)}await sleep(170)}for(const d of templeRecent()){const p=PLAYERS.find(x=>x.key===String(d.player||'').toLowerCase())||PLAYERS.find(x=>x.name.toLowerCase()===String(d.player||'').toLowerCase());events.push({type:'drop',player:d.player||'Group',key:p?.key,core:p?.core??true,date:d.date,name:d.name,itemId:d.id,notable:d.notable})}events.sort((a,b)=>b.date-a.date);saveJSON(CKEY,{savedAt:Date.now(),events});return events}
function chronicleInteresting(e){if(e.type==='drop')return true;const n=e.name.toLowerCase();return /99 |200m|100m|50m|20m|10m|1000 |500 |250 |100 /.test(n)||e.measure==='kills'}
let chronoFilter='highlights';async function renderChronicle(force=false){const host=$('#chronicle');if(!host)return;host.innerHTML='<div class="notice">Loading WOM achievements and cached Temple drops…</div>';let ev=await loadChronicle(force);if(chronoFilter==='highlights')ev=ev.filter(e=>e.type==='drop'||(/99 |200m|100m|50m/.test(e.name.toLowerCase())||(e.measure==='kills'&&+String(e.name).match(/\d+/)?.[0]>=500)));else if(chronoFilter==='milestones')ev=ev.filter(e=>e.type==='achievement');else if(chronoFilter==='drops')ev=ev.filter(e=>e.type==='drop');else if(chronoFilter==='core')ev=ev.filter(e=>e.core);else if(chronoFilter==='side')ev=ev.filter(e=>!e.core);ev=ev.filter(chronicleInteresting).slice(0,500);let year=null,h='';for(const e of ev){const y=new Date(e.date).getFullYear();if(y!==year){h+=`<div class="chronicle-year">${y}</div>`;year=y}const p=playerByKey(e.key),side=e.core===false?'side':'',notable=e.notable?'notable':'';h+=`<article class="chronicle-event ${side} ${notable}"><div class="chronicle-date">${dateTime(e.date)}${e.accuracy>0?` · WOM accuracy ±${Math.round(e.accuracy/36e5)}h`:''}</div><div class="chronicle-main">${e.type==='drop'?`<img src="https://static.runelite.net/cache/item/icon/${e.itemId}.png" alt="">`:''}<div><h4>${esc(e.player)} · ${esc(e.name)}</h4><p>${e.type==='drop'?(e.notable?'Notable Temple Collection Log addition':'Temple Collection Log addition'):`WOM milestone · ${nice(e.metric||'')}`}${side?' · supporting cast':''}</p></div></div></article>`}host.innerHTML=h||'<div class="notice">No Chronicle events matched this filter.</div>';const meta=$('#chronicleMeta');if(meta)meta.textContent=`${ev.length} events shown · WOM milestones + Temple recent drops`;$$('[data-chrono-filter]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.chronoFilter===chronoFilter))}
function bindChronicle(){const refresh=$('#chronicleRefresh');if(refresh)refresh.onclick=async()=>{refresh.disabled=true;localStorage.removeItem(CKEY);await renderChronicle(true);refresh.disabled=false};$$('[data-chrono-filter]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{chronoFilter=b.dataset.chronoFilter;renderChronicle()})}
function renderHistory(){const host=$('#historyCoverage');if(host){host.innerHTML=PLAYERS.map(p=>`<div class="kpi"><span>${p.name}${p.core?'':' · side'}</span><b>${state.profiles[p.key]?dateOnly(state.profiles[p.key]?.registeredAt):'—'}</b><small style="font-size:8px;color:#746957">WOM tracking registered</small></div>`).join('')}const c=$('#historyCta');if(c)c.innerHTML='<a class="btn" href="time-machine.html">Open Time Machine →</a> <a class="btn" href="chronicle.html">Open Chronicle →</a>'}
let modal=null;async function skillTimeline(p,skill,range){const cache=loadJSON(HKEY)||{},ck=`timeline:${p.key}:${skill}:${range}`,hit=cache[ck];if(hit?.data?.length)return hit.data;let u=`${API}/players/${encodeURIComponent(p.name)}/snapshots/timeline?metric=${encodeURIComponent(skill)}`;if(range!=='all'){const d=+range;if(d===7)u+='&period=week';else if(d===30)u+='&period=month';else if(d===365)u+='&period=year';else{const end=new Date(),start=new Date(+end-d*864e5);u+=`&startDate=${encodeURIComponent(start.toISOString())}&endDate=${encodeURIComponent(end.toISOString())}`}}try{const j=await fetchJSON(u,{attempts:2}),data=(Array.isArray(j)?j:[]).map(x=>({date:x.date||x.createdAt,value:+x.value})).filter(x=>Number.isFinite(x.value)&&x.value>=0).sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.date)-new Date(b.date));cache[ck]={savedAt:Date.now(),data};saveJSON(HKEY,cache);return data}catch{return []}}
function ensureModal(){if(modal)return modal;modal=document.createElement('div');modal.className='modal';modal.hidden=true;modal.innerHTML=`<div class="modal-dialog"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">THREE-PLAYER SKILL HISTORY</div><h2 id="modalTitle"></h2><div class="section-note">Core trio overlaid. All history is the default outside Recent Progress.</div></div><button class="modal-close">Close</button></div><div class="modal-periods">${[['all','All'],[365,'1Y'],[180,'6M'],[90,'3M'],[30,'1M'],[7,'1W']].map(([r,l])=>`<button data-modal-range="${r}">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div><div id="modalStatus" class="notice"></div><div id="modalChart" class="skill-modal-chart"></div><div class="legend">${CORE.map(p=>`<span><i style="background:${p.color}"></i>${p.name}</span>`).join('')}</div></div>`;document.body.append(modal);$('.modal-close',modal).onclick=()=>modal.hidden=true;modal.onclick=e=>{if(e.target===modal)modal.hidden=true;const b=e.target.closest('[data-modal-range]');if(b)renderSkillModal(modal.dataset.skill,b.dataset.modalRange)};document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')modal.hidden=true});return modal}
async function openSkill(skill,recent=false){const m=ensureModal();m.dataset.skill=skill;m.hidden=false;$('#modalTitle',m).textContent=nice(skill)+' XP';await renderSkillModal(skill,recent?String(state.period):'all')}
async function renderSkillModal(skill,range){const m=ensureModal();$$('[data-modal-range]',m).forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.modalRange===String(range)));$('#modalStatus',m).textContent=`Loading ${nice(skill)} · ${range==='all'?'all history':PERIODS[+range]||range+' days'}…`;const series=[];for(const p of CORE){series.push({name:p.name,color:p.color,data:await skillTimeline(p,skill,range)});await sleep(120)}drawLine($('#modalChart',m),series);$('#modalStatus',m).textContent=`${series.reduce((n,s)=>n+s.data.length,0)} WOM timeline datapoints · cached in this browser.`}
function globalClicks(){document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const s=e.target.closest('[data-skill]');if(s){e.preventDefault();openSkill(s.dataset.skill,s.dataset.recent==='1')}})}
async function renderPage(){renderMast();updateDataStatus();const pg=document.body.dataset.page;if(pg==='home')renderOverview();else if(pg==='hiscores')renderHiscores();else if(pg==='progress')await renderProgress();else if(pg==='gim')renderGim();else if(pg==='history')renderHistory();else if(pg==='time')await renderTimeMachine();else if(pg==='chronicle'){bindChronicle();await renderChronicle()}}
async function init(){bindCommon();globalClicks();await Promise.all([loadTemple(),loadWomCurrent(false)]);await gainForPeriod(365);$$('[data-period-button]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',+x.dataset.periodButton===state.period));await renderPage()}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);else init();
})();
